newsitem.title: FRANCE: Lyon-Satolas Jan-Nov airfreight traffic up 8.3pct.
newsitem.headline: Lyon-Satolas Jan-Nov airfreight traffic up 8.3pct.

text.p: January-November airfreight handled at Lyon-Satolas airport totalled 19,570 tonnes, up 8.3 percent on the same period in 1995, airport authority figures show.
Air cargo traffic on European Union routes, mostly in the form of express shipments, accounted for 8,674 tonnes, up 14.9 percent on January-November 1995.
United Parcel Service of America Inc, DHL Worldwide Express and TNT Express Worldwide each operate air cargo services at Lyon-Satolas.
In September 1996, UPS launched feeder flights between Lyon and three other French cities -- Bordeaux, Toulouse and Nice -- using two-tonne capacity Beechcraft 1900 aircraft.
January-November 1996 postal traffic handled at Lyon-Satolas totalled 12,429 tonnes, up 2.7 percent on the same period of last year.
